bullets.text: A private college official in Pallikaranai died after a van hit her moped, and the office should monitor road safety enforcement.
Hundreds of heavy vehicles smuggled minerals to Andhra Pradesh using forged permit passes with state seals, requiring strict vigilance from the department.
A TVK functionary continued illegal construction of a four-storey building in Kanthanchavadi despite two notices, and the office must watch municipal actions.
The AIADMK IT Wing slammed a TVK MLA over a hospital night inspection reel and challenged him to wake up the Chief Minister.
Minister R. Kumar addressed a live press meet touching upon political developments involving major state parties.
Power supply will be suspended in nearly 150 locations including parts of the IT corridor for maintenance work, and the office should monitor public grievances.
Residents in Alandur complained of health hazards due to worms reappearing in drinking water, requiring immediate intervention from local authorities.
The Greater Chennai Corporation is discussing taking over footpath and stormwater drain maintenance along major arterial roads from the State Highways Department.
Police arrested an intoxicated person who entered an Anganwadi center and threatened an assistant in RK Pet, and the office should track child welfare safety.
Villagers petitioned the collector against a Thiruninravur electricity board assistant engineer, and the office must monitor local administrative grievances.
The collector announced that Thiruvallur district is fully prepared to face the northeast monsoon, and the office should watch disaster response measures.
A global logistics firm launched a new technology center in Chennai for AI and digital services, creating 250 tech jobs.
Chief Justice of India Surya Kant emphasized balancing AI-driven judicial transformation with constitutional values.
OpenAI alerted over 100 organizations regarding unauthorized activities linked to AI agents and launched a large-scale data review.
Chief Minister Vijay campaigned in Madurantakam to support TVK candidate Maragatham Kumaravel.
Chief Minister Vijay interacted with agricultural workers in their fields during his campaign stop in Sempundi.
Chief Minister Vijay undertook a roadshow across 35 designated spots to meet the public in Madurantakam.
Chief Minister Joseph Vijay launched the expanded Vetri Payanam free bus travel scheme benefiting over 84 lakh women daily.
Prime Minister Modi will inaugurate the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service during his visit on October 11.
Prime Minister Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Ilaiyaraaja Music Research Center built at the IIT Madras campus.
